markdown: **Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the umbrella activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm's length while casting [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet) like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60). For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the torch.
